text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: Are you free for a while? Could I ask you to look after one of the Horsegirls on my team until the『Fukushima Kinen』?

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: I have to focus on training the Horsegirls racing in Tokyo that same day, so it'll be difficult for me to accompany her on the trip.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
The『Fukushima Kinen』is a 2000m graded stakes. 
She's been on a losing streak at that distance, so I want to fix that before it turns into a mental block for her.
choice_data_list: Sure, leave it to me

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: Thanks! Sorry to dump this on you when you've got scouting preparations of your own.
choice_data_list: <size=38>It's only natural to put the Horsegirls first!</size>

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: Haha, that's exactly why I know I can trust you with this. I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(A substitute trainer… 
I didn't know trainers covered for each other like that.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Have you decided which race you'll be entering in the upcoming Semiannual Race Meet…? I'm… still torn between the 1600 and 1800…

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I'm doing the mile, obviously! It's our big chance twice a year to run against the seniors who've already debuted! I really wanna race against Taiki!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (Semiannual Race Meet… What should I do? Running in it while still wondering if I should quit racing altogether is just—)

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Chestnut Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa… My times in the final stretch were terrible… 
I need to up my stamina training if I'm gonna run 2000m.
choice_data_list: Your stamina seems fine, but let's increase it a bit just in case

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Chestnut Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Yes, please! My Trainer said I was fine too, but… I just can't stop worrying about it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (She looks — relieved. Even though she seemed so anxious just a moment ago. Is it thanks to — how the Trainer reassured her?)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Bouquet! Is something wrong?
You're going to get hurt if you don't focus.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah… I'm sorry. 
You're right… I think I'll — take a short break.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
…Haah. I ended up bothering everyone. 
I really need to focus—

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Chestnut Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Six interval runs, done! Um… I know it's a bit late to ask, but do you think I'll be ready in time for the real race?
choice_data_list: You'll be fine. But what exactly are you worried about?

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Chestnut Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Because… stamina isn't something you can build overnight, after all. Even if I work on it now…
choice_data_list: In that case, how about we do a partner run to review your pacing?

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Chestnut Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: —! Yes…! If there's still something we can do to prepare, then please! Let's do it all!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (Wow, she's like a completely different person — Having someone by your side to listen to your worries… it really helps you stay positive. Hehehe.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
——— 
…I should — get back to training too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ———Haah.
choice_data_list: Do you have a minute? I have a favor to ask you
Do you have a minute? I have a favor to ask you

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Oh!? Me—?
choice_data_list: <size=36>Yeah. Could I ask you to be a running partner?</size>
<size=36>Yeah. Could I ask you to be a running partner?</size>

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I would be more than happy to be your running partner. So — how would you like me to run?
choice_data_list: <size=40>Could you just run how you normally do?</size>
<size=40>Could you just run how you normally do?</size>

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Chestnut Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
You said this was to help me review my pacing, right?
Are you used to running longer distances, Bouquet?
choice_data_list: Yeah. I think it'll be a good reference for your pacing

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—She waits at the back, I see. 
Because of that — it's so easy for me to run.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —The fourth corner is coming up. Time for the final push!

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Chestnut Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: —! I see, so it's here! Haaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Chestnut Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I managed to push all the way to the end! 
But my time didn't change that much, did it?
choice_data_list: Yeah, pacing was your main issue here

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Chestnut Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: I see. I feel so much better now that I know why I wasn't improving! Bouquet, do you think we could run together again sometime!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'd love to. 
I would also — be delighted to run with you again.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(The scenery passing by. 
The wind brushing against my cheeks — it felt so wonderful.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ah — Trainer. Thank you for your hard work today.
choice_data_list: <size=36>Good work. Thanks for partnering with us today</size>

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Oh, no, thank you for inviting me. For the first time in a while — I truly felt the joy of running.
choice_data_list: Haha, I guess running really is what Horsegirls do best
Haha, I guess running really is what Horsegirls do best

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's true. —Being able to use my running to help someone else — Being able to create "harmony"… it made me so happy.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I — started racing because I was captivated by the beauty of "harmony."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: But I'm just not very good at competing. Even in races, I can't bring myself to push forward — and by holding back, I feel like I'm disrupting that harmony.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I know it's wrong, but I can't change… I just end up ruining it for everyone. Their harmony — Their brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —I truly believe I should quit racing. But… still—
choice_data_list: You can take all the time you need to find your answer

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: …But running with these kinds of feelings weighing me down — Isn't it disrespectful to everyone else…?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: When everyone else is burning with such a fierce desire to win… My running — can hardly be called sincere…
choice_data_list: But you're hesitating because you still want to run, aren't you?
But you're hesitating because you still want to run, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—! …Yes. 
Even though I know it isn't sincere. I……
choice_data_list: <size=40>It's perfectly okay to follow your own heart</size>
<size=40>It's perfectly okay to follow your own heart</size>

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ……Really…?
choice_data_list: It's your racing career, after all. You should think it over carefully
It's your racing career, after all. You should think it over carefully

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Trainer……

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes… I will think about it. 
Until this hesitation — completely fades away.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—Trainer, you're always there for me… 
Why are your words — so warm…?)
